patterns: PYQs here are direct world-railway recall: Canadian Pacific = Montreal-Vancouver; Trans-Siberian = Moscow-Vladivostok (APPSC G1 2024); cities on/off the Trans-Siberian route.
Ranking items recur: railway length by country, densest network, highest road density state (Kerala).
Old keys can be outdated (UPPSC 2014 rail-length order) - India is now 4th after USA, China, Russia.
App leans heavily on 2025-26 current-affairs data (LEADS, DFC, logistics cost %, budget waterways) and multi-statement items, while PYQs are single-fact.
APPSC Bharatmala (2019) and PMGSY purpose are the main policy-scheme angles.
